kernel.governing_law: Four agents held in temporal containment are released at a precisely appointed composite moment to execute a measured fraction of killing, using instrumental cavalry whose appearance is described by simile and whose emissions flow outward from bounded mouths.
kernel.mutated_relation: Beyond the threshold, containment is not lifted but dissolved: the four agents are no longer held-then-released but ARE the temporal coordinates themselves (hour/day/month/year exist as the agents' body, not their leash); killing one-third becomes transmuting one-third into the medium of destruction (fire/smoke/brimstone become not what issues from mouths but what the victims become); the simile 'as lion-heads' collapses so that likeness is identity — riders and horses and emissions are a single fused plasma-entity whose count (200,000,000) now names not an army but a new element's particle-population.

clause_map.note: Temporal containment → temporal identity; agents ARE the hour; killing → transmutation
Numeral 200M + witness-hearing persist; counting survives phase-change
Simile (ὡς) collapses; emission from mouths → total medium; rider/horse distinction dissolves

artifacts.enantiomorph_translation:
**9:15** And the four hours were diffused — those that had become the angel — into sun-arc and moon and season, so that they might transmute one-third of the living.

**9:16** And the number of the particles of the element was two myriads of myriads; I heard the number of them.

**9:17** And thus I saw the particles in the vision and what they bore within them, having hues of ash and violet and gold-fire; and the forms of the particles were forms of lions, and into their mouths were entering flesh and breath and bone.

independent.recovered_law: In Text A, four angels are released to kill a third of humanity, and destructive substances (fire, smoke, brimstone) flow outward from the mouths of the horses. In Text B, four hours are poured out toward an angel to reshape a third of the living, and substances (flesh, breath, bones) flow inward into the mouths of the bodies — reversing the agent/patient direction and the outward-to-inward flow.
independent.law_match_note: The recovered claim identifies a real structural/relational change (reversal of agent-patient roles, outward-to-inward flow direction), which partially overlaps the declared mutation (agents become temporal coordinates, victims become the medium of destruction, collapse of simile into identity), but the specific transformations described differ significantly — the declared change is about fusion/identity-collapse while the recovered change is about directional reversal.
independent.terminal_note: The reversed directionality (εἰσεπορεύοντο inward vs. ἐκπορεύεται outward) is maintained through the final verse, so no reversion occurs.
